messages.subject: geom_cladelabel with italic fonts
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

How to use italic fonts for the clade label via geom_cladelabel ? Is there any specific option ?

Best regard,
Noppol.
messages.body_snippet:
Hi,

How to use italic fonts for the clade label via geom_cladelabel ? Is there any specific option ?

Best regard,
Noppol.

messages.subject: Re: geom_cladelabel with italic fonts
messages.body_plain:
try:
set.seed(123)
tr <- rtree(30)
ggtree(tr) + xlim(NA, 5) +
     geom_cladelabel(node=41, label='italic(abc)', parse=T)

and also examples in https://guangchuangyu.github.io/software/ggtree/faq/.

messages.subject: number of digits removed in version 1.14?
messages.subject_clean: number of digits removed in version 1.14?
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I used to be able to specify the number of digits to show on my tree but in the updated version this no longer seems to be an option.
Is there still a simple way to do this?

For example, the following used to round my posterior values to 2 digits

ggtree(mytree, aes(color=branch.length), ndigits=2) + geom_text(aes(x=branch, label=posterior), size=2)

But in the current version the error "Warning: Ignoring unknown parameters: ndigits" occurs.

Any guidance would be appreciated. Thank you.

messages.subject: Re: how to label node ages correctly in ggtree?
messages.subject_clean: how to label node ages correctly in ggtree?
messages.body_plain:
Apologies, I deleted my post because I found out what I did wrong.

The command line version of tree annotator (v1.10.1) does not automatically pick median heights for the MCC tree. It uses "keep" - I'm not sure what that is exactly. Once I specified which type I wanted (using -heights median), the x-axis and the node ages calculated as "mrsd-height_median"  match up fine.

Best,
Divya

messages.subject: Error in read.hyphy
messages.body_plain:
Dear users,

I have had no issues with read.hyphy function in the past, but for some reason I am running into all sorts of issues with this round. The only difference I can think of is the nexus file, which I have tried to automate by assembly in R, but I have tried reformatting it more times than you can count, so maybe this isn't the problem, but then I have no idea what is. The number of taxa line up nicely, the number of nodes line up nicely, so I can't understand why I keep getting errors like the following as if the numbers do not actually line up:

> > Error in names(seq) <- label :
> >   'names' attribute [531] must be the same length as the vector [443]

and

> > Error in getSubsLabel(seqs, label[pp[i]], label[i], translate, removeGap) :
> >   seqA should have equal length to seqB

I just can't seem to get past this, so ANY help would certainly be appreciated. I have attached the required tree, ASR file, and fasta file if anyone can find the time to take a look.
